train_starspace_model: create a StarSpace model using sw.starSpace(args) and train it on tagged text data
predict_tags_for_text: use sp.predictTags to predict the top k tags for a given input text string
find_nearest_neighbors: use sp.nearestNeighbor to find the top k nearest neighbors for a given word
save_and_load_model: save a trained StarSpace model with sp.saveModel and reload it with sp.initFromSavedModel
export_model_to_tsv: export a trained StarSpace model to TSV format using sp.saveModelTsv and load with sp.initFromTsv
